title: Royaume bi fi sovereign bi jeexee te kenn gisu ko
intro: Taarix xamna xeetu njiit bu nekk, waaye ñu néew ñoo yor nguur gu mel ni lii. Ndax ngelaw li ci boppam nangu na seen ndigal, te kenn mënul gis liggéeykat yi ñuy liggéey ci noppi, nguur googu wuute na ak yeneen nguur yu njëkk wala yu ginaaw. Waaye ba ci buur yi gëna mag dañu wara jeex, te bi buur bii jeexee, dëgg gi génn ci lu woyof lool, te kenn musul xalaat ni dina ko gëm.
clues: Sama Boroom jox nama nguur gu yaatu, ñu wax ko ci xët yu sell yi.
Maa ngi donn xam-xam bu rëy ak kiliftéef ci sama waajur bu ma jiitu ci jaamu Yàlla.
Maa ngi santaane ngelaw li, mu dem fu sori ngir samay mébet.
Mbindéef yu nit ñi dul gis ñu ngi liggéey ci sama kiliftéef, di tabax mbir yu yéeme yu kenn mënul méngale.
Ay ndox yu am përëm yuy seey dañu may wal, muy barke bu amul fenn ci barke yi Yàlla tànn.
Bima jogee ci àdduna, sama yaram dafa taxaw ci benn yatt. Bi mbindéef bu ndaw ci kaw suuf lekkee ci yat wi, ci la ñi ma wër xam ni jàll naa.

ñu sànni leen ci safara gu tàng

trial.answer: Dee gi feeñ ci mbindéef buy lekk ci sama yatt

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Jinn yi wéy di ligéey ba lekk ndaw ya .
Sama askan mucc nañu ci gaal gu mag
Benn jaay doole daa suux ci géej gi
Ngelaw lu metti yàq na réew mu am doole
Dañu ma yëkkati asamaan si di dundu
outcome.answer: Jinn yi wéy di ligéey ba lekk ndaw ya .

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
